title: Referee ground truth v1 — atomic propositions from Purchok's Blo rig (S06857E4) via Napper's translation
semantics: is_a: specific illustration subjects. pervasion: generic class subjects — 'whatever is <reason> is necessarily <predicate>'. Negative propositions evaluate as negations. Non-existent subjects: positive predicates false, negative predicates true.

argon_consultation_001_check.note: The six worked ontology facts in knowledge/argon_consultation_001.md were checked against the text: (1) prime cognizer don gcig its definition 'a new incontrovertible knower' — SUPPORTED (def at char 12385ff); Argon's wording 'newly and non-deceptively aware' is a paraphrase, Napper's rendering used instead. (2) conceptual / non-conceptual 'gal ba — SUPPORTED (threefold division). (3) direct perceiver mu gsum within non-conceptual, witness a consciousness seeing two moons — SUPPORTED (non-conceptual facsimile/wrong consciousness; cf. S25 here). (4) prime cognizer x direct perceiver mu bzhi — SUPPORTED (text's own pervasion statement at char 19369ff). (5) prime cognizer x conceptual mu bzhi — SUPPORTED by the same witnesses. (6) subsequent cognizer x direct perceiver mu bzhi — SUPPORTED. One correction to Argon: the definition 'that which is clear and knowing' is the text's definition of consciousness (shes pa); the definition of awareness (blo) itself is 'a knower' (rig pa).

set_relations.note: Established in the text's debate at the terminological-divisions section.

set_relations.relation: 'gal ba — mutually exclusive (contradictory by definition: newly incontrovertible vs not newly incontrovertible)

'gal ba — mutually exclusive: a prime cognizer is a new realizer; a subsequent cognizer realizes what has already been realized. The word 'new' in the definition of prime cognizer exists to eliminate subsequent cognizers.
'gal ba — mutually exclusive: a direct perceiver is by definition free from conceptuality.

mu gsum — three-corner: sense direct perceiver is pervaded by direct perceiver, direct perceiver by awareness; neither converse holds (a mental direct perceiver is not a sense direct perceiver; an inferential cognizer is an awareness but not a direct perceiver).

pair: inferential cognizer by the power of the fact
set_relations.relation: mu gsum — three-corner: whatever is an inferential cognizer through renown is necessarily an inferential cognizer by the power of the fact, but not conversely.

mu bzhi — four-corner: both = a direct prime cognizer (e.g., first moment of a sense direct perceiver apprehending form); direct perceiver only = second moment of a sense direct perceiver; prime cognizer only = an inferential cognizer; neither = a wrong consciousness.

mu bzhi — four-corner: both = second moment of a sense direct perceiver; direct perceiver only = its first moment; subsequent cognizer only = second moment of an inferential cognizer; neither = a correctly assuming consciousness.

mu bzhi — four-corner: both = doubt thinking sound is probably permanent (a conceptual wrong consciousness); doubt only = doubt tending toward the factual; wrong only = a thought apprehending sound as permanent; neither = a prime cognizer. The text explicitly refutes the claim that the two are contradictory, citing Khedrup.

pair: awareness to which an object appears but is not ascertained
set_relations.relation: overlap attested on three corners in this text: both = e.g. a sense direct perceiver apprehending form while the mind is attracted to a pleasant sound; direct perceiver only = a direct prime cognizer (it necessarily induces ascertainment regarding its object per the text's reply); the text gives NO illustration of an awareness to which an object appears but is not ascertained that is not a direct perceiver — the fourth corner is not posited here.
